ClientResponses.Response:
Hello, we are sorry to hear about the issue you are experiencing with your grill. It sounds like you may be activating a safety device built into the regulator. To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

Please contact our support team if you continue to experience an issue after following these steps. We would be happy to provide further assistance. Thanks!

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello. We are sorry to hear that the side of your grill is rusting out. 
If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips.

1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.
2. Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.
3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming.
4. The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

Replacement parts for your grill are available through our call center, so feel free to call our team from 7 am to 8 pm CST, any day. Thank you.

Results.ReviewText:
Great quality (standard with Weber products). This grill met all of our needs and fit perfectly on our balcony without taking up too much space. 
Although it certainly is not the biggest grill, there is still plenty of space to grill and the heat variability from one burner to the other makes it easy to cook multiple things at different temperatures simultaneously.
When we bought the grill it did not come with a cover (which is new, our first weber grill came with one). As such, we ended up buying a weber cover to specifically fit our E-210 grill - my only comment in terms of areas of improvement is that I wish the covers were a bit more secure. Ours is held in place by two velcro straps on either side (kind of like a sinch). However, when its very windy out (common where we live), I am always checking to see if the cover is still around - it has not blown off yet, but its come very very close. As such, it would be nice if instead of velcro straps the cover came with clips and/or hooks to secure the cover to the underside of the grill.

Other than that small thing, everything about our E-210 has been amazing. If you are looking for a good quality grill, but do not have a ton of space to work with this is grill is you best bet hands down.
Results.Title: Great Quality, value and fun to grill on!
